title: ‘Days of Thunder’ Star Randy Quaid Says Anne Hathaway Is ‘Woke’ and a ‘Horrible Choice’ for the Sequel: ‘You Need the Original Girl’
content:
ByJack Dunn

“Days of Thunder” star Randy Quaid sounded off onAnne Hathawayafter it wasrevealed that she has joined Tom Cruisein the racing drama’s upcoming sequel.

“We need Nicole [Kidman] back,”Quaid wrote on X Saturday. “Don’t be a pussy, [Tom Cruise]. You need the original girl. It’s not personal; it’s filmmaking. Anne isn’t sexy, because and if you haven’t noticed, she’s pregnant.”

Headded in a follow-up post, “Anne Hathaway is a leftist, woke, horrible choice for ‘DAYS OF THUNDER’ NASCAR audience who are MAGA. The sexy older chick for Tom in this film needs to be Nicole. That’s the casting that would sell the idea. It’s interesting because when we made the first one there was also a rush to get it out; editors slept in the cutting room on shifts. This is a weird thing, like they want it to come out and tank.”

Reps forParamountand Hathaway did not immediately respond toVariety’s request for comment.

In the original “Days of Thunder,” Quaid played Tim Daland, the owner of the racing team that recruits Cruise’s up-and-coming driver Cole Trickle. As noted by Quaid, Nicole Kidman played Dr. Claire Lewicki, the romantic lead in the film. Other cast members include Robert Duvall, Cary Elwes and John C. Reilly. Tony Scott served as director.

Varietyexclusively reportedHathaway’s involvement in the “Days of Thunder” sequel. Paramount has slated the film for a June 2028 theatrical release. The project was shot for Imax and will hit screens nearly 40 years after the original.
title_zh: 《雷霆萬鈞》(Days of Thunder) 的明星蘭迪·奎德(Randy Quaid)表示安妮·海瑟薇(Anne Hathaway)是「覺醒」的代表，並且是續集的「糟糕選擇」： 「你需要原來的女孩。」
content_zh:
作者：傑克·鄧恩 (Jack Dunn)

《雷霆萬鈞》(Days of Thunder) 的明星蘭迪·奎德 (Randy Quaid) 對安妮·海瑟薇 (Anne Hathaway) 發表了評論，因為她被透露將與湯姆·克魯斯 (Tom Cruise) 一起參加這部賽車劇的即將推出的續集。

奎德在週六於X平台上寫道：“我們需要妮可·基嫚 (Nicole Kidman) 回來。不要當懦夫，湯姆·克魯斯。你需要原來的女孩。這不是個人問題；這是電影製作。安妮不性感，如果你還沒注意到，她懷孕了。”

他在隨後的帖子中補充道：“安妮·海瑟薇是一個左派、覺醒的、對於《雷霆萬鈞》(DAYS OF THUNDER) 的納斯卡觀眾來說是可怕的選擇，他們是支持MAGA的。這部電影中湯姆需要的性感年長女性必須是妮可。這才是能夠賣出這個概念的選角。這很有趣，因為當我們拍第一部時，也有急於推出的情況；編輯們在剪輯室裡輪班睡覺。這是一個奇怪的情況，就像他們想讓它推出卻又想讓它失敗。”

派拉蒙 (Paramount) 和海瑟薇的代表尚未立即回應《綜藝》(Variety) 的評論請求。

在原版《雷霆萬鈞》(Days of Thunder) 中，奎德飾演了賽車隊的擁有者蒂姆·達蘭德 (Tim Daland)，他招募了克魯斯飾演的潛力駕駛員科爾·特里克爾 (Cole Trickle)。正如奎德所提到的，妮可·基嫚在電影中飾演浪漫女主角克萊爾·路維基 (Dr. Claire Lewicki)。其他演員包括羅伯特·杜瓦爾 (Robert Duvall)、凱瑞·艾爾維斯 (Cary Elwes) 和約翰·C·賴利 (John C. Reilly)。托尼·史考特 (Tony Scott) 擔任導演。

《綜藝》(Variety) 獨家報導了海瑟薇參與《雷霆萬鈞》(Days of Thunder) 續集的消息。派拉蒙已將該片定於2028年6月上映。該項目是為IMAX拍攝的，將在原版上映近40年後登上銀幕。
